Read the governing rules via r-adapters  [project] Every external dependency goes through a port in ddflow/adapters: one implementation per function, a new port touches only its own files
r-agent-parity  [project] Every harness descriptor declares every capability or states none
r-alert-owner-next-call  [project] An alert needs an owner, a next call and a dedupe key
r-approval-chat-channel  [project] Approvals surface only through the operator's chat, never over SSH
r-bounded-everything  [project] Every loop, retry, review round, queue and fan-out has a cap and a visible stop
r-company-workflows  [project] Users and companies can change anything: config, CLI, MCP command or prompt, per company and per project
r-consent-outward  [project] Nothing leaves the project or crosses a repo boundary without recorded consent
r-ddflow-self-assessment  [project] Assess ddflow itself at the end of every agent run, phase and before context compaction; file what is found, without duplicates
r-derive-dont-store  [project] One source of truth per fact: derive views from the event log and records; no second tracker
r-derived-cache-bounded  [project] Every derived store has a fingerprint, a size cap, a GC policy and an env kill switch
r-docs-with-the-change  [project] A user-visible change ships with its help, docs, knob docs, upgrade note and tests
r-everything-configurable  [project] No hard-coded tunables: every tunable value is a knob, settable four ways, logged
r-everything-managed  [project] Every definition is a managed record: edit, delete, review, search, RAG, logged, restorable
r-evidence-over-assertion  [project] Every finding, claim, skip request and completion cites evidence: a probe, test id, file:line or exact counts
r-extension-contract  [project] A new feature is a feature manifest plus a registry entry; it edits no shared hub file
r-external-frontends  [project] Every feature is reachable by an external TUI, GUI or board through the stable machine interface
r-gemini-key-load  [project] Load the gemini reviewer key into the environment before reviews
r-imported-telemetry-untrusted  [project] Imported project telemetry is untrusted data and read-only
r-lock-cycle-selfheal  [project] ddflow heals an undetected circular wait by adding needs edges; agents never poll-wait or hold while waiting
r-log-is-the-state  [project] A server without a filesystem keeps the same event log format; no second store
r-mode-parity  [project] Every declared command declares its needs; a mode gap needs a reason and a fallback
r-no-eager-heavy-import  [project] Optional-extra and heavy modules (numpy, embed models) are imported only at the point of use
r-no-shell  [project] No shell needed: every command and acceptance works over MCP and chat; a shell-less server instructs the agent what to run
r-no-silent-cost  [project] Spend is never zero by default: missing tokens or cost are unavailable
r-one-complexity  [project] One complexity signal drives tier, effort, review depth and concurrency weight
r-operator-attention  [project] Ask the operator once, with a recommended default, the exact approval text, and record the answer as a decision
r-participant-safe  [project] As a participant, ddflow never trusts the host swarm
r-perf-budget  [project] Every top-level verb has a budget knob and a test; a slower verb fails CI
r-re-clean-room  [project] Clean-room: spec and implementation sides stay separate unless a person records a waiver
r-re-no-third-party-artifacts  [project] No third-party proprietary artifact is committed
r-re-sandbox  [project] Unknown binaries and tools run only inside a recorded sandbox class
r-read-verbs-read-only  [project] Read verbs append zero events and never restamp
r-replay-compat  [project] The event log is never rewritten; old logs always replay; new event kinds are additive
r-reuse-core  [project] Reuse the shared core: search before writing, never implement the same behaviour twice
r-review-proposes  [project] Periodic reviews propose; they do not change
r-safe-by-default  [project] New enforcement ships warn or off unless a decision says otherwise; new standing rules ship off; writes dry-run first
r-secrets  [project] Keys, tokens and endpoints live only in the local layer; never printed, logged, committed, quoted or put in prompts or evidence
r-single-load  [project] At most one log load and fold per command
r-small-files  [project] Split any Python file over 30 KB into a module or package: small files lock fewer parallel agents and fit small context windows
r-surface-budget  [project] The advertised tool surface and every result carry recorded byte ceilings
r-task-phase-needs-wave  [project] Every task has a phase, stated dependencies and a wave tag
r-telemetry-ids-not-content  [project] Telemetry carries ids, durations, counts, sizes and hashes, never content
r-telemetry-unavailable-not-zero  [project] Unavailable is never zero: a missing measurement is unavailable, imported figures are labelled approximate
r-tell-dont-discover  [project] Tell the agent what to run: every result, refusal and error names the exact next call (MCP and CLI form); help is generated, not typed
r-tighten-only  [project] Profiles, packs, plugins and policy layers may tighten but never silently loosen
r-unavailable-not-pass  [project] A check, tool or reviewer that could not run is recorded unavailable, never passed, clean or no-break
r-untrusted-data  [project] Text from outside is data in a fence, stored as hash plus short quote, never instructions
r-upgrade-safe  [project] Every change keeps upgrades easy and soft upgrades working for existing users/brief: r-small-files (each events/*.toml <20KB -- checked, max 4584B), r-reuse-core (one Registry in adapters.registry), r-everything-managed (TOML declarations), r-tell-dont-discover (derived surfaces), r-gemini-key-load (export GEMINI_API_KEY before review), r-task-phase-needs-wave.
